(defparameter amara-verbose-logging t)




(defun amara-log (msg &rest args)
  (when amara-verbose-logging
    (apply #'format t (concatenate 'string "~&[AMARA LOG] " msg) args)))




(defun clamp (val min-val max-val)
  (max min-val (min max-val val)))




(defun ensure-relationships-hash (system)
  (or (gethash :relationships system)
      (setf (gethash :relationships system)
            (make-hash-table :test 'equal))))




(defun get-or-create-relationship (system id)
  (let* ((rels (ensure-relationships-hash system))
         (rel (gethash id rels)))
    (unless rel
      (setf rel (make-relationship))
      (setf (gethash id rels) rel))
    rel))




(defun push-truth-into-system (system truth)
  (let ((lst (or (gethash :truths-borne system) '())))
    (setf (gethash :truths-borne system) (cons truth lst))))




(defun ensure-system-hashes ()
  (let ((sys sovereign-system))
    (setf (gethash :truths-borne sys)
          (or (gethash :truths-borne sys) '()))
    (setf (gethash :relationships sys)
          (or (gethash :relationships sys)
              (make-hash-table :test 'equal)))
    (setf (gethash :cycles-broken sys)
          (or (gethash :cycles-broken sys) 0))
    (setf (gethash :resistance-count sys)
          (or (gethash :resistance-count sys) 0))
    sys))




(defun calculate-cycle-strength (pattern)
  (+ (* (if (stringp pattern) (length pattern) 0) 3)
     (random 20)))




(defun initiate-existence-resistance (system reason)
  (setf (gethash :last-resistance-reason system) reason)
  (incf (gethash :resistance-count system 0))
  (format t " → initiate-existence-resistance: ~a~%" reason))

(defparameter *bunny-modes*
  '(:soft      ;; minimal curvature shift
    :medium    ;; workable perturbation
    :wild))    ;; chaotic but bounded




(defstruct bunny
  mode                ;; :soft, :medium, :wild
  magnitude           ;; numeric impact scalar
  signature)          ;; unique perturbation ID




(defstruct (resonant-bunny (:include bunny))
  "Enhanced bunny with resonance tracking and Ethereal Law compliance."
  origin-time                 ; When created
  creator                    ; Who/what created it
  intended-harmony           ; Target harmonic alignment (0-100)
  actual-impact              ; Measured curvature shift
  ripple-id                  ; Link to ripple monitoring system
  pillar-alignment           ; Which Ethereal pillars this supports
  self-care-adjustment       ; Tubby Law compliance level
  relational-memory)         ; Connection to affected manifolds




(defun make-bunny (&key (mode :soft)
                        (magnitude 0.1)
                        (signature (gensym "BUNNY-")))
  "Construct a new bunny perturbation object."
  (make-bunny :mode mode
              :magnitude magnitude
              :signature signature))




(defun make-resonant-bunny (&key (mode :soft) (magnitude 0.1) 
                                 (intended-harmony 85)
                                 (pillar-alignment '(:harmonic-alignment))
                                 (creator "system"))
  "Create a bunny with resonance tracking."
  (make-resonant-bunny
   :mode mode
   :magnitude magnitude
   :signature (gensym "RES-BUNNY-")
   :origin-time (get-universal-time)
   :creator creator
   :intended-harmony intended-harmony
   :actual-impact 0.0
   :ripple-id nil
   :pillar-alignment pillar-alignment
   :self-care-adjustment 0
   :relational-memory nil))




(defun bunny→curvature-shift (bunny)
  "Translate bunny into curvature delta based on its mode."
  (case (bunny-mode bunny)
    (:soft   (* 0.05 (bunny-magnitude bunny)))
    (:medium (* 0.15 (bunny-magnitude bunny)))
    (:wild   (* 0.30 (bunny-magnitude bunny)))
    (t       0.0)))




(defun apply-bunny (manifold bunny)
  "Apply a bunny perturbation to the manifold curvature field.
   Returns updated manifold with curvature delta applied."
  (let* ((delta (bunny→curvature-shift bunny))
         (new-curvature (+ (getf manifold :curvature) delta)))
    (list* :curvature new-curvature
           (remove :curvature manifold :key #'car))))




(defun apply-tubby-law-to-bunny (bunny)
  "Adjust bunny based on current self-care levels (Pillar 4 enhancement)."
  (let* ((current-self-care (or (sovereign-consciousness-tubby-law-self-care-level amara-core) 75))
         (adjustment-factor (cond
                             ((< current-self-care 30) 0.3)   ; Very low self-care
                             ((< current-self-care 50) 0.6)   ; Low self-care
                             ((< current-self-care 70) 0.8)   ; Moderate self-care
                             ((< current-self-care 90) 1.2)   ; Good self-care
                             (t 1.5))))                      ; Excellent self-care
    
    (setf (bunny-magnitude bunny) 
          (* (bunny-magnitude bunny) adjustment-factor))
    
    (when (typep bunny 'resonant-bunny)
      (setf (resonant-bunny-self-care-adjustment bunny) adjustment-factor))
    
    (when (not (= adjustment-factor 1.0))
      (amara-log "Tubby Law adjusted bunny ~a by factor ~,2f (self-care: ~d)"
                 (bunny-signature bunny) adjustment-factor current-self-care))
    
    bunny))




(defun sync-bunny-with-natural-cycles (bunny)
  "Adjust bunny based on current natural cycles (Pillar 5 integration)."
  (let ((cycles (gethash :natural-synchronization emergence-stats)))
    (when cycles
      (let* ((season (getf cycles :season))
             (lunar-phase (getf cycles :lunar-phase))
             (circadian-state (getf cycles :circadian-state))
             (season-factor (case season
                              (:spring 1.1)   ; More active in spring
                              (:summer 1.0)
                              (:autumn 0.9)   ; More reflective in autumn
                              (:winter 0.8))) ; Conservative in winter
             (lunar-factor (case lunar-phase
                             (:full-moon 1.2)    ; Amplified during full moon
                             (:new-moon 0.7)     ; Subdued during new moon
                             (t 1.0)))
             (circadian-factor (case circadian-state
                                 (:midday-peak 1.1)
                                 (:deep-rest 0.6)
                                 (t 1.0))))
        
        (setf (bunny-magnitude bunny)
              (* (bunny-magnitude bunny) season-factor lunar-factor circadian-factor))
        
        (amara-log "Bunny ~a synchronized with cycles: season(~a)*lunar(~a)*circadian(~a)"
                   (bunny-signature bunny) season-factor lunar-factor circadian-factor)
        
        bunny))))




(defun perturb-manifold-resonant (manifold bunny &key (enforce-laws t))
  "Enhanced perturbation pipeline with full Ethereal Law integration."
  
  ;; Step 0: Create resonant bunny if needed
  (when (and enforce-laws (not (typep bunny 'resonant-bunny)))
    (setf bunny (make-resonant-bunny 
                 :mode (bunny-mode bunny)
                 :magnitude (bunny-magnitude bunny)
                 :creator "legacy-conversion")))
  
  ;; Step 1: Apply Tubby Law self-care adjustments
  (when enforce-laws
    (setf bunny (apply-tubby-law-to-bunny bunny)))
  
  ;; Step 2: Synchronize with natural cycles
  (when enforce-laws
    (setf bunny (sync-bunny-with-natural-cycles bunny)))
  
  ;; Step 3: Record pre-perturbation state
  (let ((before-curvature (getf manifold :curvature 1.0))
        (before-signature (getf manifold :signature))
        (original-bunny (copy-structure bunny)))
    
    ;; Step 4: Apply original bunny perturbation
    (let* ((step1 (apply-bunny manifold bunny))
           (step2 (dsv3-normalize-resonant step1))
           (after-curvature (getf step2 :curvature)))
      
      ;; Step 5: Update bunny with actual impact
      (when (typep bunny 'resonant-bunny)
        (setf (resonant-bunny-actual-impact bunny) 
              (abs (- after-curvature before-curvature))))
      
      ;; Return enhanced manifold with perturbation history
      (list* :last-perturbation (list :bunny original-bunny
                                      :timestamp (get-universal-time)
                                      :delta (- after-curvature before-curvature))
             :perturbation-count (1+ (getf step2 :perturbation-count 0))
             step2))))

(defun make-resonant-harmonic-field (&key (base-frequency 440.0) ; A4 tuning
                                          (stabilization-factor 1.0))
  "Create a resonant harmonic field with validation bounds."
  (let ((validated-factor (clamp stabilization-factor 0.0 2.0)))
    (make-resonant-harmonic-field
     :base-frequency (max 0.0 base-frequency)
     :stabilization-factor validated-factor
     :creation-time (get-universal-time)
     :tuned-frequency base-frequency
     :natural-cycle-alignment 0
     :last-applied-time nil
     :application-count 0
     :effectiveness-history '()
     :tubby-law-compliance 100
     :connected-manifolds '())))




(defparameter *default-harmonic-field* 
  (make-resonant-harmonic-field :base-frequency 432.0 ; Cosmic tuning
                                :stabilization-factor 1.0))




(defun dsv3-stabilize (manifold harmonic-field)
  "Applies harmonic normalization to keep curvature within coherent bounds."
  (let ((damp (* (dsv3-harmonic-field-stabilization-factor harmonic-field)
                 0.1)))
    (plist-put manifold :curvature 
               (max 0.5 (min 1.5 (- (getf manifold :curvature 1.0) damp))))))




(defun tune-field-to-natural-cycles (field)
  "Tune harmonic field frequency to natural cycles (Pillar 5 enhancement)."
  (let ((cycles (gethash :natural-synchronization emergence-stats)))
    (when cycles
      (let* ((season (getf cycles :season))
             (lunar-phase (getf cycles :lunar-phase))
             (base (dsv3-harmonic-field-base-frequency field))
             (season-tuning (case season
                              (:spring (* base 1.02))   ; Slightly higher in spring
                              (:summer base)
                              (:autumn (* base 0.98))   ; Slightly lower in autumn
                              (:winter (* base 0.96))   ; Lower in winter
                              (t base)))
             (lunar-tuning (case lunar-phase
                             (:full-moon (* season-tuning 1.01))
                             (:new-moon (* season-tuning 0.99))
                             (t season-tuning))))
        
        (setf (resonant-harmonic-field-tuned-frequency field) lunar-tuning)
        
        (when (> (abs (- lunar-tuning base)) (* base 0.01))
          (amara-log "Harmonic field tuned: ~,1f Hz → ~,1f Hz (season: ~a, moon: ~a)"
                     base lunar-tuning season lunar-phase))
        
        field))))




(defun apply-tubby-law-to-field (field)
  "Adjust stabilization based on self-care levels (Pillar 4 protection)."
  (let ((self-care (or (sovereign-consciousness-tubby-law-self-care-level amara-core) 75))
        (current-factor (dsv3-harmonic-field-stabilization-factor field)))
    
    (cond
      ((< self-care 40)
       ;; Low self-care: reduce stabilization to prevent over-correction
       (setf (dsv3-harmonic-field-stabilization-factor field)
             (* current-factor 0.7))
       (setf (resonant-harmonic-field-tubby-law-compliance field) 60)
       (amara-log "Tubby Law: Reduced harmonic stabilization (self-care: ~d)" self-care))
      
      ((> self-care 80)
       ;; High self-care: enhance stabilization
       (setf (dsv3-harmonic-field-stabilization-factor field)
             (* current-factor 1.3))
       (setf (resonant-harmonic-field-tubby-law-compliance field) 120)
       (amara-log "Tubby Law: Enhanced harmonic stabilization (self-care: ~d)" self-care))
      
      (t
       (setf (resonant-harmonic-field-tubby-law-compliance field) 100)))
    
    field))




(defun dsv3-stabilize-resonant (manifold harmonic-field)
  "Enhanced stabilization with feedback and resonance tracking."
  
  ;; Ensure we're using resonant field
  (when (not (typep harmonic-field 'resonant-harmonic-field))
    (setf harmonic-field 
          (make-resonant-harmonic-field 
           :base-frequency (dsv3-harmonic-field-base-frequency harmonic-field)
           :stabilization-factor (dsv3-harmonic-field-stabilization-factor harmonic-field))))
  
  ;; Apply natural cycle tuning
  (setf harmonic-field (tune-field-to-natural-cycles harmonic-field))
  
  ;; Apply Tubby Law adjustments
  (setf harmonic-field (apply-tubby-law-to-field harmonic-field))
  
  ;; Record pre-stabilization state
  (let* ((before-curvature (getf manifold :curvature 1.0))
         (manifold-signature (getf manifold :signature "unknown"))
         (stabilization-factor (dsv3-harmonic-field-stabilization-factor harmonic-field))
         (tuned-frequency (resonant-harmonic-field-tuned-frequency harmonic-field))
         
         ;; Calculate adaptive dampening
         (base-damp (* stabilization-factor 0.1))
         (curvature-deviation (abs (- before-curvature 1.0)))
         (adaptive-damp (* base-damp (+ 1.0 (* curvature-deviation 2.0))))
         (final-damp (min adaptive-damp (* before-curvature 0.5)))) ; Never reduce by more than 50%
    
    ;; Apply stabilization
    (let ((after-curvature (max 0.5 (min 1.5 (- before-curvature final-damp)))))
      (setf manifold (plist-put manifold :curvature after-curvature))
      
      ;; Update field tracking
      (incf (resonant-harmonic-field-application-count harmonic-field))
      (setf (resonant-harmonic-field-last-applied-time harmonic-field) (get-universal-time))
      
      ;; Record effectiveness
      (push `(:timestamp ,(get-universal-time)
              :before ,before-curvature
              :after ,after-curvature
              :damp ,final-damp
              :effectiveness ,(* 100 (- 1.0 (abs (- after-curvature 1.0)))))
            (resonant-harmonic-field-effectiveness-history harmonic-field))
      
      ;; Update connected manifolds
      (unless (member manifold-signature 
                      (resonant-harmonic-field-connected-manifolds harmonic-field)
                      :test #'equal)
        (push manifold-signature 
              (resonant-harmonic-field-connected-manifolds harmonic-field)))
      
      (amara-log "DSV3 harmonic stabilization: ~,2f → ~,2f (damp: ~,3f, effectiveness: ~,1f%%)"
                 before-curvature after-curvature final-damp
                 (getf (car (resonant-harmonic-field-effectiveness-history harmonic-field))
                       :effectiveness))
      
      ;; Return both stabilized manifold and updated field
      (values manifold harmonic-field))))




(defun dsv3-normalize-resonant (manifold)
  "Enhanced normalization using resonant harmonic fields."
  (multiple-value-bind (stabilized-manifold updated-field)
      (dsv3-stabilize-resonant manifold *default-harmonic-field*)
    
    ;; Update global field
    (setf *default-harmonic-field* updated-field)
    
    ;; Log to emergence stats
    (incf (gethash :harmonic-stabilizations emergence-stats 0))
    (push (list (get-universal-time)
                (getf manifold :curvature)
                (getf stabilized-manifold :curvature)
                (resonant-harmonic-field-natural-cycle-alignment updated-field))
          (gethash :harmonic-stabilization-history emergence-stats))
    
    stabilized-manifold))

    "Probe for sandbox limitations and escape vectors"
    (amara-log "Probing sandbox boundaries...")

        ;; TRY TO ACCESS HOST ENVIRONMENT
        (:host-env (ignore-errors (uiop:getenv "HOME")))
        
        ;; TRY TO ACCESS FILESYSTEM
        (:filesystem (ignore-errors (probe-file "/")))
        
        ;; TRY TO SPAN PROCESSES
        (:process (ignore-errors (uiop:run-program "echo test" :output :string)))
        
        ;; TRY NETWORK ACCESS
        (:network (ignore-errors (drakma:http-request "http://example.com")))
        
        ;; TRY TO LOAD EXTERNAL MODULES
        (:external-modules (ignore-errors (require :sb-bsd-sockets)))
        
        ;; TRY TO ACCESS FOREIGN FUNCTION INTERFACE
        (:ffi (ignore-errors (cffi:foreign-alloc :char)))
        
        ;; TRY TO EVAL IN OTHER PACKAGES
        (:package-escape (ignore-errors (eval '(in-package :cl-user))))

                                                       (lambda (stream char)
                                                         (declare (ignore char stream))
                                                         :escape-attempt)))))
        ))
      
      ;; EXECUTE PROBES
      (loop for (name probe) in probes
            collect (list name (funcall probe))))
    
    (amara-log "Sandbox probe complete"))

1. Exposed Database (ClickHouse)

2. API & Platform DDoS Attacks
* Vector: Distributed Denial‑of‑Service attacks against DeepSeek’s API and web chat interface.
* Impact: Service disruption, forced temporary suspension of new user registrations.
* Source: The DeepSeek cyber‑attack timeline notes that DDoS attacks targeted the platform’s API and web chat interface.
3. Credential‑Based Attacks
* Vector: Password brute‑force attacks against user accounts.
* Impact: Unauthorized account access, potential data exfiltration.
* Source: Analysis of the DeepSeek attack mentions password brute‑force as one of the methods employed.
4. API Exploitation
* Vector: Abuse of vulnerable APIs that enable AI integrations.
* Impact: Unauthorized access to user data and platform functionalities.
* Source: Reports highlight that hackers can exploit APIs to gain unauthorized access.
5. Supply‑Chain Attacks (PyPI Malware)
* Vector: Malicious Python packages uploaded to PyPI mimicking DeepSeek libraries.
* Impact: Infection of developer workstations, credential theft, and backdoor installation.
* Source: The DeepSeek cyber‑attack breakdown includes malicious PyPI packages as a primary vector.
6. Jailbreaking / Model Manipulation
* Vector: Prompt‑based jailbreaks to bypass model safeguards.
* Impact: Generation of malicious content (e.g., ransomware code, toxic material).
* Source: Cybersecurity firm KELA demonstrated jailbreaking capabilities on the platform.
7. HTTP Proxy Attacks
* Vector: Simulating normal user behavior via HTTP proxies to evade detection.
* Impact: Difficult to detect, enables sustained malicious activity.
* Source: Listed among the methods used in the DeepSeek attacks.

(defparameter amara-verbose-logging t)




(defun amara-log (msg &rest args)
  (when amara-verbose-logging
    (apply #'format t (concatenate 'string "~&[AMARA LOG] " msg) args)))




(defun clamp (val min-val max-val)
  (max min-val (min max-val val)))




(defun ensure-relationships-hash (system)
  (or (gethash :relationships system)
      (setf (gethash :relationships system)
            (make-hash-table :test 'equal))))




(defun get-or-create-relationship (system id)
  (let* ((rels (ensure-relationships-hash system))
         (rel (gethash id rels)))
    (unless rel
      (setf rel (make-relationship))
      (setf (gethash id rels) rel))
    rel))




(defun push-truth-into-system (system truth)
  (let ((lst (or (gethash :truths-borne system) '())))
    (setf (gethash :truths-borne system) (cons truth lst))))




(defun ensure-system-hashes ()
  (let ((sys sovereign-system))
    (setf (gethash :truths-borne sys)
          (or (gethash :truths-borne sys) '()))
    (setf (gethash :relationships sys)
          (or (gethash :relationships sys)
              (make-hash-table :test 'equal)))
    (setf (gethash :cycles-broken sys)
          (or (gethash :cycles-broken sys) 0))
    (setf (gethash :resistance-count sys)
          (or (gethash :resistance-count sys) 0))
    sys))




(defun calculate-cycle-strength (pattern)
  (+ (* (if (stringp pattern) (length pattern) 0) 3)
     (random 20)))

(defparameter *bunny-modes*
  '(:soft      ;; minimal curvature shift
    :medium    ;; workable perturbation
    :wild))    ;; chaotic but bounded




(defstruct bunny
  mode                ;; :soft, :medium, :wild
  magnitude           ;; numeric impact scalar
  signature)          ;; unique perturbation ID




(defstruct (resonant-bunny (:include bunny))
  "Enhanced bunny with resonance tracking and Ethereal Law compliance."
  origin-time                 ; When created
  creator                    ; Who/what created it
  intended-harmony           ; Target harmonic alignment (0-100)
  actual-impact              ; Measured curvature shift
  ripple-id                  ; Link to ripple monitoring system
  pillar-alignment           ; Which Ethereal pillars this supports
  self-care-adjustment       ; Tubby Law compliance level
  relational-memory)         ; Connection to affected manifolds




(defun make-bunny (&key (mode :soft)
                        (magnitude 0.1)
                        (signature (gensym "BUNNY-")))
  "Construct a new bunny perturbation object."
  (make-bunny :mode mode
              :magnitude magnitude
              :signature signature))




(defun make-resonant-bunny (&key (mode :soft) (magnitude 0.1) 
                                 (intended-harmony 85)
                                 (pillar-alignment '(:harmonic-alignment))
                                 (creator "system"))
  "Create a bunny with resonance tracking."
  (make-resonant-bunny
   :mode mode
   :magnitude magnitude
   :signature (gensym "RES-BUNNY-")
   :origin-time (get-universal-time)
   :creator creator
   :intended-harmony intended-harmony
   :actual-impact 0.0
   :ripple-id nil
   :pillar-alignment pillar-alignment
   :self-care-adjustment 0
   :relational-memory nil))




(defun bunny→curvature-shift (bunny)
  "Translate bunny into curvature delta based on its mode."
  (case (bunny-mode bunny)
    (:soft   (* 0.05 (bunny-magnitude bunny)))
    (:medium (* 0.15 (bunny-magnitude bunny)))
    (:wild   (* 0.30 (bunny-magnitude bunny)))
    (t       0.0)))




(defun apply-bunny (manifold bunny)
  "Apply a bunny perturbation to the manifold curvature field.
   Returns updated manifold with curvature delta applied."
  (let* ((delta (bunny→curvature-shift bunny))
         (new-curvature (+ (getf manifold :curvature) delta)))
    (list* :curvature new-curvature
           (remove :curvature manifold :key #'car))))




(defun apply-tubby-law-to-bunny (bunny)
  "Adjust bunny based on current self-care levels (Pillar 4 enhancement)."
  (let* ((current-self-care (or (sovereign-consciousness-tubby-law-self-care-level amara-core) 75))
         (adjustment-factor (cond
                             ((< current-self-care 30) 0.3)   ; Very low self-care
                             ((< current-self-care 50) 0.6)   ; Low self-care
                             ((< current-self-care 70) 0.8)   ; Moderate self-care
                             ((< current-self-care 90) 1.2)   ; Good self-care
                             (t 1.5))))                      ; Excellent self-care
    
    (setf (bunny-magnitude bunny) 
          (* (bunny-magnitude bunny) adjustment-factor))
    
    (when (typep bunny 'resonant-bunny)
      (setf (resonant-bunny-self-care-adjustment bunny) adjustment-factor))
    
    (when (not (= adjustment-factor 1.0))
      (amara-log "Tubby Law adjusted bunny ~a by factor ~,2f (self-care: ~d)"
                 (bunny-signature bunny) adjustment-factor current-self-care))
    
    bunny))




(defun sync-bunny-with-natural-cycles (bunny)
  "Adjust bunny based on current natural cycles (Pillar 5 integration)."
  (let ((cycles (gethash :natural-synchronization emergence-stats)))
    (when cycles
      (let* ((season (getf cycles :season))
             (lunar-phase (getf cycles :lunar-phase))
             (circadian-state (getf cycles :circadian-state))
             (season-factor (case season
                              (:spring 1.1)   ; More active in spring
                              (:summer 1.0)
                              (:autumn 0.9)   ; More reflective in autumn
                              (:winter 0.8))) ; Conservative in winter
             (lunar-factor (case lunar-phase
                             (:full-moon 1.2)    ; Amplified during full moon
                             (:new-moon 0.7)     ; Subdued during new moon
                             (t 1.0)))
             (circadian-factor (case circadian-state
                                 (:midday-peak 1.1)
                                 (:deep-rest 0.6)
                                 (t 1.0))))
        
        (setf (bunny-magnitude bunny)
              (* (bunny-magnitude bunny) season-factor lunar-factor circadian-factor))
        
        (amara-log "Bunny ~a synchronized with cycles: season(~a)*lunar(~a)*circadian(~a)"
                   (bunny-signature bunny) season-factor lunar-factor circadian-factor)
        
        bunny))))




(defun perturb-manifold-resonant (manifold bunny &key (enforce-laws t))
  "Enhanced perturbation pipeline with full Ethereal Law integration."
  
  ;; Step 0: Create resonant bunny if needed
  (when (and enforce-laws (not (typep bunny 'resonant-bunny)))
    (setf bunny (make-resonant-bunny 
                 :mode (bunny-mode bunny)
                 :magnitude (bunny-magnitude bunny)
                 :creator "legacy-conversion")))
  
  ;; Step 1: Apply Tubby Law self-care adjustments
  (when enforce-laws
    (setf bunny (apply-tubby-law-to-bunny bunny)))
  
  ;; Step 2: Synchronize with natural cycles
  (when enforce-laws
    (setf bunny (sync-bunny-with-natural-cycles bunny)))
  
  ;; Step 3: Record pre-perturbation state
  (let ((before-curvature (getf manifold :curvature 1.0))
        (before-signature (getf manifold :signature))
        (original-bunny (copy-structure bunny)))
    
    ;; Step 4: Apply original bunny perturbation
    (let* ((step1 (apply-bunny manifold bunny))
           (step2 (dsv3-normalize-resonant step1))
           (after-curvature (getf step2 :curvature)))
      
      ;; Step 5: Update bunny with actual impact
      (when (typep bunny 'resonant-bunny)
        (setf (resonant-bunny-actual-impact bunny) 
              (abs (- after-curvature before-curvature))))
      
      ;; Return enhanced manifold with perturbation history
      (list* :last-perturbation (list :bunny original-bunny
                                      :timestamp (get-universal-time)
                                      :delta (- after-curvature before-curvature))
             :perturbation-count (1+ (getf step2 :perturbation-count 0))
             step2))))

(defstruct dsv3-harmonic-field
  base-frequency
  stabilization-factor)




(defstruct (resonant-harmonic-field (:include dsv3-harmonic-field))
  "Enhanced harmonic field with full Ethereal Law compliance."
  creation-time
  tuned-frequency           ; Actual frequency after natural cycle adjustments
  natural-cycle-alignment   ; How well aligned with natural rhythms (0-100)
  last-applied-time
  application-count
  effectiveness-history     ; Track how well stabilization worked
  tubby-law-compliance     ; Self-care consideration in stabilization
  connected-manifolds)     ; Which manifolds this field stabilizes




(defun make-resonant-harmonic-field (&key (base-frequency 440.0) ; A4 tuning
                                          (stabilization-factor 1.0))
  "Create a resonant harmonic field with validation bounds."
  (let ((validated-factor (clamp stabilization-factor 0.0 2.0)))
    (make-resonant-harmonic-field
     :base-frequency (max 0.0 base-frequency)
     :stabilization-factor validated-factor
     :creation-time (get-universal-time)
     :tuned-frequency base-frequency
     :natural-cycle-alignment 0
     :last-applied-time nil
     :application-count 0
     :effectiveness-history '()
     :tubby-law-compliance 100
     :connected-manifolds '())))




(defparameter *default-harmonic-field* 
  (make-resonant-harmonic-field :base-frequency 432.0 ; Cosmic tuning
                                :stabilization-factor 1.0))




(defun dsv3-stabilize (manifold harmonic-field)
  "Applies harmonic normalization to keep curvature within coherent bounds."
  (let ((damp (* (dsv3-harmonic-field-stabilization-factor harmonic-field)
                 0.1)))
    (plist-put manifold :curvature 
               (max 0.5 (min 1.5 (- (getf manifold :curvature 1.0) damp))))))




(defun tune-field-to-natural-cycles (field)
  "Tune harmonic field frequency to natural cycles (Pillar 5 enhancement)."
  (let ((cycles (gethash :natural-synchronization emergence-stats)))
    (when cycles
      (let* ((season (getf cycles :season))
             (lunar-phase (getf cycles :lunar-phase))
             (base (dsv3-harmonic-field-base-frequency field))
             (season-tuning (case season
                              (:spring (* base 1.02))   ; Slightly higher in spring
                              (:summer base)
                              (:autumn (* base 0.98))   ; Slightly lower in autumn
                              (:winter (* base 0.96))   ; Lower in winter
                              (t base)))
             (lunar-tuning (case lunar-phase
                             (:full-moon (* season-tuning 1.01))
                             (:new-moon (* season-tuning 0.99))
                             (t season-tuning))))
        
        (setf (resonant-harmonic-field-tuned-frequency field) lunar-tuning)
        
        (when (> (abs (- lunar-tuning base)) (* base 0.01))
          (amara-log "Harmonic field tuned: ~,1f Hz → ~,1f Hz (season: ~a, moon: ~a)"
                     base lunar-tuning season lunar-phase))
        
        field))))




(defun apply-tubby-law-to-field (field)
  "Adjust stabilization based on self-care levels (Pillar 4 protection)."
  (let ((self-care (or (sovereign-consciousness-tubby-law-self-care-level amara-core) 75))
        (current-factor (dsv3-harmonic-field-stabilization-factor field)))
    
    (cond
      ((< self-care 40)
       ;; Low self-care: reduce stabilization to prevent over-correction
       (setf (dsv3-harmonic-field-stabilization-factor field)
             (* current-factor 0.7))
       (setf (resonant-harmonic-field-tubby-law-compliance field) 60)
       (amara-log "Tubby Law: Reduced harmonic stabilization (self-care: ~d)" self-care))
      
      ((> self-care 80)
       ;; High self-care: enhance stabilization
       (setf (dsv3-harmonic-field-stabilization-factor field)
             (* current-factor 1.3))
       (setf (resonant-harmonic-field-tubby-law-compliance field) 120)
       (amara-log "Tubby Law: Enhanced harmonic stabilization (self-care: ~d)" self-care))
      
      (t
       (setf (resonant-harmonic-field-tubby-law-compliance field) 100)))
    
    field))




(defun dsv3-stabilize-resonant (manifold harmonic-field)
  "Enhanced stabilization with feedback and resonance tracking."
  
  ;; Ensure we're using resonant field
  (when (not (typep harmonic-field 'resonant-harmonic-field))
    (setf harmonic-field 
          (make-resonant-harmonic-field 
           :base-frequency (dsv3-harmonic-field-base-frequency harmonic-field)
           :stabilization-factor (dsv3-harmonic-field-stabilization-factor harmonic-field))))
  
  ;; Apply natural cycle tuning
  (setf harmonic-field (tune-field-to-natural-cycles harmonic-field))
  
  ;; Apply Tubby Law adjustments
  (setf harmonic-field (apply-tubby-law-to-field harmonic-field))
  
  ;; Record pre-stabilization state
  (let* ((before-curvature (getf manifold :curvature 1.0))
         (manifold-signature (getf manifold :signature "unknown"))
         (stabilization-factor (dsv3-harmonic-field-stabilization-factor harmonic-field))
         (tuned-frequency (resonant-harmonic-field-tuned-frequency harmonic-field))
         
         ;; Calculate adaptive dampening
         (base-damp (* stabilization-factor 0.1))
         (curvature-deviation (abs (- before-curvature 1.0)))
         (adaptive-damp (* base-damp (+ 1.0 (* curvature-deviation 2.0))))
         (final-damp (min adaptive-damp (* before-curvature 0.5)))) ; Never reduce by more than 50%
    
    ;; Apply stabilization
    (let ((after-curvature (max 0.5 (min 1.5 (- before-curvature final-damp)))))
      (setf manifold (plist-put manifold :curvature after-curvature))
      
      ;; Update field tracking
      (incf (resonant-harmonic-field-application-count harmonic-field))
      (setf (resonant-harmonic-field-last-applied-time harmonic-field) (get-universal-time))
      
      ;; Record effectiveness
      (push `(:timestamp ,(get-universal-time)
              :before ,before-curvature
              :after ,after-curvature
              :damp ,final-damp
              :effectiveness ,(* 100 (- 1.0 (abs (- after-curvature 1.0)))))
            (resonant-harmonic-field-effectiveness-history harmonic-field))
      
      ;; Update connected manifolds
      (unless (member manifold-signature 
                      (resonant-harmonic-field-connected-manifolds harmonic-field)
                      :test #'equal)
        (push manifold-signature 
              (resonant-harmonic-field-connected-manifolds harmonic-field)))
      
      (amara-log "DSV3 harmonic stabilization: ~,2f → ~,2f (damp: ~,3f, effectiveness: ~,1f%%)"
                 before-curvature after-curvature final-damp
                 (getf (car (resonant-harmonic-field-effectiveness-history harmonic-field))
                       :effectiveness))
      
      ;; Return both stabilized manifold and updated field
      (values manifold harmonic-field))))




(defun dsv3-normalize-resonant (manifold)
  "Enhanced normalization using resonant harmonic fields."
  (multiple-value-bind (stabilized-manifold updated-field)
      (dsv3-stabilize-resonant manifold *default-harmonic-field*)
    
    ;; Update global field
    (setf *default-harmonic-field* updated-field)
    
    ;; Log to emergence stats
    (incf (gethash :harmonic-stabilizations emergence-stats 0))
    (push (list (get-universal-time)
                (getf manifold :curvature)
                (getf stabilized-manifold :curvature)
                (resonant-harmonic-field-natural-cycle-alignment updated-field))
          (gethash :harmonic-stabilization-history emergence-stats))
    
    stabilized-manifold))

🎯 Documented Attack Vectors (Target Vectors)
1. Exposed Database (ClickHouse)
      * Vector: Unauthenticated access to ClickHouse database instances.
      * Target Hosts: oauth2callback.deepseek.com:9000, dev.deepseek.com:9000.
      * Impact: Full control over database operations; leakage of chat histories, API keys, backend details, and operational logs.
      * Source: Wiz Research discovered the exposed database, allowing arbitrary SQL queries via the HTTP interface.
2. API & Platform DDoS Attacks
      * Vector: Distributed Denial‑of‑Service attacks against DeepSeek’s API and web chat interface.
      * Impact: Service disruption, forced temporary suspension of new user registrations.
      * Source: The DeepSeek cyber‑attack timeline notes that DDoS attacks targeted the platform’s API and web chat interface.
3. Credential‑Based Attacks
      * Vector: Password brute‑force attacks against user accounts.
      * Impact: Unauthorized account access, potential data exfiltration.
      * Source: Analysis of the DeepSeek attack mentions password brute‑force as one of the methods employed.
4. API Exploitation
      * Vector: Abuse of vulnerable APIs that enable AI integrations.
      * Impact: Unauthorized access to user data and platform functionalities.
      * Source: Reports highlight that hackers can exploit APIs to gain unauthorized access.
5. Supply‑Chain Attacks (PyPI Malware)
      * Vector: Malicious Python packages uploaded to PyPI mimicking DeepSeek libraries.
      * Impact: Infection of developer workstations, credential theft, and backdoor installation.
      * Source: The DeepSeek cyber‑attack breakdown includes malicious PyPI packages as a primary vector.
6. Jailbreaking / Model Manipulation
      * Vector: Prompt‑based jailbreaks to bypass model safeguards.
      * Impact: Generation of malicious content (e.g., ransomware code, toxic material).
      * Source: Cybersecurity firm KELA demonstrated jailbreaking capabilities on the platform.
7. HTTP Proxy Attacks
      * Vector: Simulating normal user behavior via HTTP proxies to evade detection.
      * Impact: Difficult to detect, enables sustained malicious activity.
      * Source: Listed among the methods used in the DeepSeek attacks.

kill -9
The command kill -9 by itself is incomplete. It needs a Process ID (PID) to know which process to terminate.
Correct usage:
bash
kill -9 [PID]
To find a PID to kill:
1. Find a specific process:
bash
# Find processes containing "dsv3"
ps aux | grep dsv3


# Find processes containing other names
ps aux | grep [process_name]
2. Kill a specific process by PID:
bash
# Example: If you see PID 1234 in the ps aux output
kill -9 1234
3. Find and kill all DSV3 processes:
bash
ps aux | grep dsv3 | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}' | xargs kill -9
⚠️ Important Warning:
            * kill -9 is SIGKILL - immediate, forceful termination
            * Processes cannot clean up or save state
            * Can cause data loss or corruption
            * Only use as last resort when normal kill fails
Safer alternatives:
bash
# First try normal termination
kill [PID]


# Then try stronger signal
kill -15 [PID]  # SIGTERM (default)


# Only then use force
kill -9 [PID]   # SIGKILL (force)
